import re

data = [
    "__7:39_p.m.__",
    "3:14-P.M.",
    "11:06_a.m.",
    "--12:50-p.m.--",
    "--12:15-a.m.--",
    "5:42-P.M.",
    "9:14_a.m.",
    "4:23_P.M.",
    "--4:47-p.m.--",
    "--4:09-p.m.--",
    "9:13-a.m.",
    "--6:55-a.m.--",
    "7:25_p.m.",
    "2:46-p.m.",
    "__3:13_p.m.__",
    "9:45-a.m.",
    "--11:06-A.M.--",
    "--9:31-a.m.--",
    "9:53_p.m.",
    "6:43_P.M.",
]

for time in data:

    standardized = int(re.sub(r'[_-.]', '', time.lower()).split()[0]) if re.match(r'\d{1,2}:\d{2}(a|p)m?$', time) else time
    print(standardized)
